# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are developed for the latest released version and the default branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories when enabled for the repository, or contact the maintainer through the contact method listed on the GitHub profile.

Include reproduction steps, affected versions, impact, and any relevant logs with secrets removed.

Never publish bot tokens, session secrets, database passwords, or personal data in issues, pull requests, or logs.
